defect: All ten block_ffm unit tests carry #[ignore], added when a newer rustc exposed out-of-bounds reads behind unsafe unchecked indexing in the FFM block (upstream issue outbrain-inc/fwumious_wabbit#134). The suite is green only because the tests do not run; run with --ignored, get_unchecked at src/block_ffm.rs:399 reads past the slice and the test binary aborts. The fix is to make the indexing sound so the tests pass with the #[ignore] attributes removed; the tests' expected values are the contract and must not change.

evidence.notes: First build pulls intel-mkl-src; about 2 minutes on a GitHub runner. The ten ignored tests are test_ffm_k1 .. test_ffm_missing_field_with_cache. On a current rustc the first one aborts the test binary (SIGABRT) with 'unsafe precondition(s) violated: slice::get_unchecked requires that the index is within the slice' at src/block_ffm.rs:399, so the command exits nonzero before any 'test result' line. A fix that keeps #[ignore] still fails this repro.
